song: 61 - Shakira - Hips Don't Lie (featuring Wyclef Jean) (Official 4K Video) ft. Wyclef Jean
title: the horn stabs strobe the room
story: Hips Don't Lie opens on a quiet bar (rms 0.05) with a full-frame flash on the opening hit at 8. Each dembow snare (16ths 4, 7, 12, 15) pulses the glow and alterna flips, the kick punches duty and zoom, and the trumpet stabs sweep barrido and the borde edge, all on the perreo-lime strobe. The build at 236 raises the duty bar by bar and escalates the shake on every hit until the drop at 314 flashes and shakes. After the drop the colour steps hue every two bars, the half-bar contrast swings, and the prominent hits at 805, 844 and 910 zoom and shake.
